disclosures.body_text: Official first-half and second-quarter 2026 interim financial report and results.

disclosures.title: Saudi Aramco Annual Report 2025
disclosures.body_text: Audited 2025 annual report covering consolidated financial statements, operations, strategy, governance and sustainability performance.

disclosures.title: FY 2025 earnings release
disclosures.body_text: Audited annual earnings release with income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, segment and per-share results for 2025 and comparative 2024 amounts.

disclosures.title: FY 2025 financial results
disclosures.body_text: 2025 revenue was SAR 1,559.342 billion, net income was SAR 350.210 billion, operating cash flow was SAR 510.798 billion and capital expenditure was SAR 190.444 billion.

disclosures.title: 2026 capital investment guidance
disclosures.body_text: Aramco stated 2026 capital investment guidance of USD 50 billion to USD 55 billion.

disclosures.title: Fourth quarter 2025 base dividend
disclosures.body_text: The Board declared a fourth-quarter 2025 base dividend of SAR 82.08 billion, equivalent to USD 21.89 billion.

disclosures.title: Jafurah, Tanajib and Marjan project milestones
disclosures.body_text: Jafurah commenced production, Tanajib commenced operations, and the Marjan increment came onstream during the period covered by the 2025 report.

disclosures.title: Share buyback program
disclosures.body_text: Aramco announced a share buyback program of up to SAR 11.3 billion, equivalent to USD 3 billion, over 18 months.

disclosures.title: Hydrocarbon market and production risks
disclosures.body_text: Results are exposed to crude oil and gas prices, global demand, regulation and government production decisions, in addition to operational, project and geopolitical risks.

disclosures.title: 2030 gas growth and crude capacity strategy
disclosures.body_text: Aramco targets growth in sales gas production capacity of more than 80% by 2030 compared with 2021 levels, while maintaining maximum sustainable crude capacity at 12 million barrels per day.
